title: Polynomial calculus size of Tseitin formulas on grids is exponential in the side
claim: For the a x b grid with any odd charge, every refutation of its Tseitin formula in polynomial calculus (0/1 basis) or in PCR (with twin variables), over any field of characteristic other than 2, has size at least 2^(gamma min(a,b) - O(1)) for an absolute constant gamma > 0; refutations of size 2^O(min(a,b)) poly(ab) exist, so the bound is tight up to the constant. Proof: a random restriction deleting the edges of non-corner faces at pairwise L-infinity distance at least 3 keeps at least a fifth of every cut (planar duality), so the restricted formula is Tseitin on a connected grid with holes whose balanced cuts give an explicit tangle of order about min(a,b)/15; the tangle lemma of PC-DEGREE-20261020-001B then forbids degree below about min(a,b)/30, while every monomial with that many variables is killed with probability 1 - exp(-Omega(min(a,b))).
failure_conditions: The cut lemma fails: some vertex set on a checked grid keeps less than a fifth of its cut, or a nontrivial cut vanishes.
The isoperimetric lemma fails on a checked grid.
A sampled kill frequency falls below the claimed bound beyond sampling error, or far edges are dependent.
A damaged grid's computed degree falls below the tangle bound.
A control passes: separation 2 or corner faces keep every cut at a fifth.
A published statement of the bound is found.
foundation_claim_scope: A proof-complexity size lower bound for Tseitin formulas on grids; no contact-first claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies the cut lemma exhaustively (compiled C) on every valid face selection and vertex set of six small grids, where the factor 5 is attained, and on 3,593 sampled vertex sets of 12x12 to 30x17 grids; both controls (separation 2, corner faces) break it; the isoperimetric lemma exhaustively on all grids with at most 28 vertices; selection and kill probabilities against 20,000 samples with far-edge independence; a degree sanity check by the label closure; the constant gamma; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive and sampled checks of its lemmas; the degree step uses the tangle lemma of PC-DEGREE-20261020-001B-P001 with an explicit tangle (no duality theorem needed); no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: A targeted search on 2026-10-20 (Beck-Nordstrom-Tang 2013 on XOR-substituted grids; Filmus-Lauria-Miksa-Nordstrom-Vinyals on PCR space; Mouli 2024 on bases; Itsykson-Riazanov-Smirnov 2022 on resolution and treewidth; Hastad and Hastad-Risse on bounded-depth Frege for grids) found no exponential PC or PCR size lower bound for plain grid Tseitin. The ingredients are standard; the bound may be known to specialists.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-20.
